### 1.  Sum of the solutions

If the two roots are distinct, their sum (by Vieta) is

If the discriminant is zero, the quadratic has a **single** solution

The discriminant

The infinite series \(\displaystyle\sum_{a=0}^{\infty}\frac{a}{2^{a}}\) is well‑known (or obtained by differentiating \(\sum x^{a}=1/(1-x)\)):

\[
